consent.headline: Authorize this agent
consent.intro: The agent at %host% is asking to act for you at this shop.
consent.effect: If you allow this, the agent can request and negotiate quotes on your behalf. You can have the merchant revoke it at any time.
consent.expiry: This request can only be answered once, and expires %minutes% minutes after the agent asked.
consent.expired: This authorization link has expired or has already been used. Ask the agent for a new one.
